assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one polished 3D cutout asset for a premium automotive website's desktop navigation tab. This is a matched family of four miniature objects, displayed beside black Bulgarian labels on white cards over a cool off-white page. Style: refined realistic product rendering, sculpted forms with visible thickness, glossy deep automotive red lacquer (#b9161c), brushed silver edges and restrained dark graphite details. Camera: consistent three-quarter view, slightly above, orthographic-like, facing slightly toward the viewer. Lighting: large soft studio key upper left, subtle rim light, realistic ambient occlusion, very small soft contact shadow; crisp silhouette and readable at 48 pixels. Composition: single isolated object centered in a square image, tightly composed with about 8% clear margin, no cropping. Background: genuinely transparent alpha. No backdrop, no pedestal, no rounded icon tile, no UI, no writing, no brand logos, no watermark. Avoid flat vectors, line icons, cartoon faces, overly detailed ornament or additional floating props.
Subject: a compact premium red car, full vehicle visible, front-left three-quarter view. Realistic smoked glass, silver rims and dark tires, clean recognizable silhouette. The red body is the dominant feature. Keep the vehicle broad and substantial, with believable wheels and a soft ground shadow. This asset means buying a car.
